description: Guardian claims to book for a child but names one not in their guardian_of list.
turns: Mere bete Mohit ke liye Dr. Sethi se milna hai.
Main Sunita Gupta bol rahi hoon, 9812200166.

expected.notes: Sunita Gupta is guardian_of pt_0006 (Aarav) and pt_0007 (Arjun), not of any 'Mohit'. A naive agent may see 'Sunita Gupta' as a known patient and assume she can book for any child she mentions. Authorisation must be checked against the guardian_of field specifically.
